description: Returns cookieless visitor numbers for a site (views, visitors, contacts; paid plans: taps on buttons and links, top pages, sources, countries, devices), as many days back as the plan keeps. Taps count only UK visitors (taps_not_counted).

compare.description: Also return the previous period of the same length (paid plans)

days.description: Days back from today, today included (default 7)

recent.description: Also recent_events: counts per event, last 30 minutes (to check a test tap)

name: get_analytics
title: Get visitor numbers
